question:
In the following question, out of the given four alternatives, select the alternative which best expresses the meaning of the Idiom/Phrase. 

Go with a bang
solution: The correct answer is: **Very exciting and successful**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The phrase **"Go with a bang"** means something that is very exciting and successful. (बहुत ही रोमांचक और सफल) • **Example:** The concert went with a bang, and everyone had a great time. • **"Very exciting and successful"** refers to an event or activity that is full of excitement and achieves great success. (बहुत ही रोमांचक और सफल) • **Example:** The product launch was very exciting and successful, drawing a large crowd and generating significant sales. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Party like there's no tomorrow** (ऐसा पार्टी करना मानो कोई कल नहीं है): To enjoy oneself to the fullest without thinking about future consequences. • **Example:** They decided to party like there's no tomorrow and danced all night. • **Decide according to the situation** (स्थिति के अनुसार निर्णय लेना): To make a decision based on the current circumstances. • **Example:** We need to decide according to the situation and choose the best course of action. • **To go crazy** (पागल हो जाना): To become very excited or enthusiastic about something. • **Example:** The crowd went crazy when the band started playing their hit song. 36:T496, The sentence with the incorrect spelling is: **Option 4**.
